title: Workplace safety basics
description: Hand-written example showing both reference styles (docx section and csv row). Fictional content.

questions.question: In which zone is wearing a helmet mandatory at all times?
questions.explanation: Zone B has overhead cranes operating, so helmets are required at all times there.

reference.quote: Helmets must be worn at all times in Zone B, where overhead cranes are in operation.

questions.question: How often must fire extinguishers be inspected?
questions.explanation: The manual requires a monthly visual inspection of every extinguisher.

reference.quote: Every fire extinguisher shall be visually inspected once a month and the inspection recorded on its tag.

questions.question: What does the abbreviation "PPE" stand for?
questions.explanation: The glossary defines PPE as personal protective equipment, such as helmets, gloves and safety shoes.

reference.quote: Term: PPE | Definition: Personal protective equipment (helmets, gloves, safety shoes, goggles)

questions.question: What is a "near miss"?
options: An accident that caused minor injury
A safety inspection that was postponed
An unplanned event that could have caused injury but did not
A fire alarm that was triggered by mistake
questions.explanation: A near miss is an event with the potential for harm where no one was actually hurt.

reference.quote: Term: Near miss | Definition: An unplanned event that did not result in injury but had the potential to do so
